nodes.text: Pioneering Research of Human interaction We are inventing a new way for humans to interact with AI, pushing the limits of large language models. Interaction An AI agent must communicate with the clarity, timing, and adaptability of a human expert. Interacting naturally isn't just about language. It means knowing when to listen, when to explain, when to show, and how to adjust in real time based on who's on the other side of the call. Knowledge Generic AI knowledge isn't enough. An AI agent must deeply understand a product, not just its features, but how it solves real problems. Latest Publications Reinforcement Learning in Frontier LLMs: From RLHF to Verifiable Rewards May 20, 2026 Quantizat
